loaded.title: Loaded models
loaded.intro: Loaded models. Each answers on Temper's API by its name; chat uses the first.
keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.stop: Stop the reply, or close find
keys.pages: Chat, Models, Library, Train, Datasets, Recipes, Export, Connect
settings.title: Settings
settings.zoom_hint: {mod} + and {mod} − change it anywhere; {mod} 0 resets. {mod} / lists every shortcut.
settings.language_hint: Some pages are still in English while their translations are written.
chat.empty_list: Chats you start are saved here.
chat.private: Everything runs on this computer. Nothing you type leaves it.
chat.loading_hint: Large models can take a minute to load into memory.
chat.load_first: Load a model to start chatting
chat.load_hint: Pick a GGUF model you've downloaded, or find one on Hugging Face.
chat.send_hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.summarising: Summarising earlier messages to fit the context…
chat.stopped_thinking: The model stopped while still thinking. Raise Max new tokens, or set a thinking budget, and regenerate.
chat.queue_hint: Enter to queue it for when the reply finishes
prompts.hint: Saved prompts. Type / in an empty message to find one.
prompts.empty: No prompts yet. Write a message, then save it here to reuse it.
prompts.name: Name
prompts.variables_hint: Write {{name}} for a part to fill in each time.
instr.project_hint: Its AGENTS.md files, from the repository root down, are added to the instructions.
instr.title: Instructions for every chat
instr.global_hint: Saved as AGENTS.md in Temper's folder and sent ahead of each chat's system prompt, followed by the AGENTS.md files of the chat's project folder.
instr.placeholder: For example: Answer in British English. Prefer short answers.
loaded.paused_hint: Unloaded to free the GPU; its context is saved and comes back on resume.
fit.title: This message doesn't fit in the model's context
fit.summary: It needs about {need} tokens with the room kept for the reply; the context holds {context}, so it's {over} over.
fit.none: Nothing simple makes it fit. Send a shorter message.
fit.compact: Turn on auto-compact, so earlier messages ({tokens} tokens) are summarised
fit.new_chat: Start a new chat; earlier messages take {tokens} tokens
fit.shorten_instructions: Shorten the system prompt or AGENTS.md ({tokens} tokens)
fit.longer_context: Reload the model with a context of {to} tokens (it supports up to {max})
tools.title: Tools
tools.hint: The model can call these while it answers. Small models may call them poorly or not at all.
tool.calculator.about: Works out arithmetic exactly, instead of the model guessing.
tool.current_time.about: Tells the model today's date and the time, here or in another time zone.
tools.no_answer: The model stopped after its tool calls without answering. Regenerate, or try a larger model.
tools.waiting: Waiting for you to allow it.
tool.run_python.about: Runs Python code the model writes, in a sandbox, and shows it what it printed.
tool.run_javascript.about: Runs JavaScript with Node.js, in a sandbox, and shows the model what it printed.
sandbox.title: Code sandbox
sandbox.seatbelt: Code runs in macOS's sandbox: no network, and it can only change its own folder.
sandbox.bubblewrap: Code runs in a bubblewrap sandbox: no network, and it can only change its own folder.
sandbox.none: There's no OS sandbox on this computer: code the model runs can use the network and reach your files. Keep it on Ask first.
sandbox.data_off: Python has its standard library only. Add {packages} (about 300 MB).
sandbox.remove_confirm: Remove the data libraries? Python code goes back to the standard library; you can add them again later.
sandbox.no_node: JavaScript needs Node.js; install it to let models run JavaScript.
tools.mcp_about: Its {count} tools, each asking first or running as set in Settings.
mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.about: Tools from Model Context Protocol servers, for chat models to call. Turn a server on for a chat in its Tools.
mcp.empty: No servers yet. Add one, or paste the mcpServers config another app uses.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.command_hint: The command that starts the server, with its arguments.
mcp.env_hint: One KEY=value per line, for API keys and settings.
mcp.headers_hint: One Name: value per line, such as an Authorization header.
mcp.paste_hint: Paste JSON with an mcpServers object, as Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code use.
skills.title: Skills
skills.empty_picker: No skills yet. Make one in Settings, or add one to the project's .agents/skills.
skills.about: Folders of instructions (SKILL.md) a chat brings in when you mention them, like @write-tests. A project's own skills in .agents/skills or .claude/skills come too.
skills.remove_confirm: Remove the skill {name} and its folder?
skills.name: Name
skills.name_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; you mention it as @name.
skills.description_hint: Writing unit tests for Python code
